name: Sorcerer Bloodline Transmogrifist
body:
Bloodline transmogrifists are sorcerers who use their bloodline to take on a defensive form resembling their natural connection to specific creatures.

Transmogrify Bloodline

Each bloodline transmogrifist selects a sorcerer bloodline as normal, but gains the following benefits in place of some of the bloodline’s usual benefits. This alters the sorcerer’s bloodline.

Bloodline Spells: The transmogrifist gains the summon monster spell of the appropriate level for each of his bloodline spells.

Bloodline Arcana (Su)

The bloodline transmogrifist gains the ability to transmogrify his armor as detailed above.

Bloodline Powers: In place of any of the bloodline powers granted by his bloodline, the bloodline transmogrifist can gain and use one natural attack, spell-like ability, or activated supernatural ability possessed by the creature his summon monster spell would otherwise summon. If the ability learned in this way duplicates a spell, that spell cannot be one the bloodline transmogrifist couldn’t learn to cast (due to being a higher level, or on another spell list).
